text: Yes, the 2022 loss was corroborated by the independent reference. The JRC 2020 dataset confirms that the entire event area (1.0 fraction) was mapped as forest in 2020, meeting the rule requiring ≥50% agreement. Additionally, the loss was observed in a later year (2022) within the Hansen GFC series (2001–2025), and the event area (0.6 ha) exceeded the minimum threshold (0.5 ha). While 0.2 ha of loss occurred in patches under 0.5 ha (excluded from the event), the remaining 0.4 ha met the criteria. The MGAP 2021 data further verified the area as native forest (0.5 ha).
